description.zh: 两角都从界面法线量起，n=c/v为无量纲折射率。斜光从高n到低n时可能没有实折射角；临界点与严格超临界分开。筷子插水里看起来折断、光纤把光关在芯里，都是它：入射角越大、折射角偏得越多，超过临界角就全反射。
description.en: Both angles start at the interface normal; n=c/v is dimensionless. Oblique rays from higher to lower index may have no real refraction angle. The critical limiting case is distinct from strictly supercritical incidence. A chopstick looking broken in water, and a fibre keeping light inside its core, are both this: the larger the incidence angle, the more the refracted angle bends, and past the critical angle comes total reflection.

title.zh: 法线、正弦范围与临界条件
title.en: Normal, sine range and critical conditions

body.zh: 法线垂直界面。固定均匀、无吸收介质，s=(n₁/n₂)sinθ₁；s>1没有实θ₂。仅n₁>n₂有θc=arcsin(n₂/n₁)：θ₁=θc对应沿界面极限光线，θ₁>θc为全反射。本页只算方向，不算能量比例或传播时间。
body.en: The normal is perpendicular to the interface. For fixed homogeneous, non-absorbing media, s=(n₁/n₂)sinθ₁; s>1 gives no real θ₂. Only n₁>n₂ has θc=arcsin(n₂/n₁): equality gives the limiting ray along the interface; θ₁>θc gives total internal reflection. The lesson models direction, not energy fractions or travel time.

description.zh: 非竖直直线的斜率是两点竖直坐标差除以水平坐标差，在同一直线上不变。一般单位为Y的单位除以X的单位；几何双轴同用长度单位时无量纲。
description.en: A nonvertical line’s slope is vertical-coordinate change divided by horizontal-coordinate change and stays constant along the line. Its units are Y-units per X-unit; for two geometric length axes it is dimensionless.

title.zh: 相似三角形与小孔倒像

description.zh: 在均匀介质的孔心光线模型中，物距u与屏距v均为正，带符号像高差与物高之比为−v/u；负号表示倒像，正尺寸取其绝对值。
description.en: In the homogeneous-medium central-ray model, object distance u and screen distance v are positive. Signed image-height difference divided by object height is−v/u: the negative sign marks inversion; positive size uses the absolute value.

body.zh: H与h是正的长度(cm)，h_s是按对应端点相减的带符号坐标差(cm)，M=h_s/H无量纲。物体和屏平行，孔心取原点且Y向上；相似三角形来自直线关系。这里没有透镜焦距条件；有限孔径几何模糊和极小孔衍射需分别说明。
body.en: H and h are positive lengths(cm); h_s is the signed difference between corresponding image endpoints(cm), and M=h_s/H is dimensionless. Object and screen planes are parallel, the hole is the origin, and Y points upward. Similar triangles follow the straight-line geometry. No lens focal-length condition is used; finite-aperture geometric blur and tiny-aperture diffraction have distinct scopes.

description.zh: 质点沿实际位移所受的净功等于动能变化。本理想水平弹簧中，弹簧力是唯一做非零功的力，故 Wspring=ΔK=−ΔU。
description.en: Net work along a particle’s displacement equals its kinetic-energy change. In this ideal horizontal spring, only the spring does nonzero work, so Wspring=ΔK=−ΔU.

title.zh: 本模型中的能量与单位
title.en: Energy and units in this model

body.zh: K=½mv² 是动能，U=½kx² 是弹簧弹性势能（平衡处取 U=0），E=K+U。1J=1N·m。本实验限于无阻尼、无持续驱动的理想水平弹簧；回复力仍存在。
body.en: K=½mv² is kinetic energy; U=½kx² is elastic spring energy, with U=0 at equilibrium; E=K+U. One joule is1N·m. This experiment is an ideal horizontal spring with no damping or sustained driving; restoring force remains.

description.zh: 定积分累加带符号的贡献。在正向时间区间，速度积分是位移，速率积分才是路程；位置差与位置坐标不同。
description.en: A definite integral accumulates signed contributions. Over forward time, integrating velocity gives displacement; integrating speed gives distance. Position difference is distinct from a position coordinate.

description.zh: 可微函数的导数是瞬时变化率，也是切线斜率。位置对时间的导数是带方向的速度，速度对时间的导数是加速度。
description.en: A derivative is an instantaneous rate and tangent slope. For position versus time it gives signed velocity; differentiating velocity gives acceleration.

description.zh: 在惯性参考系、质量恒定时，合外力等于质量乘加速度。它决定速度如何改变，而不是此刻速度有多大。
description.en: In an inertial frame with constant mass, the sum of external forces equals mass times acceleration. It determines how velocity changes, not the current velocity.

description.zh: 电压是每份电荷携带的能量，电流是每秒流过的电荷；两者相乘就是每秒的能量，即功率——100 瓦的灯泡每秒用掉 100 焦耳。
description.en: Voltage is energy per charge, current is charge per second; multiplied they give energy per second, which is power — a 100-watt bulb uses 100 joules every second.

description.zh: 像电路里的飞轮：电感两端电压决定电流的变化速度，电流有了“惯性”——有限电压不能使电流瞬间跳变，只能慢慢推着它变快或变慢。
description.en: Like a flywheel in a circuit: voltage across an inductor sets the rate of current change, giving current inertia — finite voltage cannot make current jump instantly, only push it faster or slower over time.

description.zh: 像一个极小的蓄水池：流入正端的电流给它充电、电压随存量上升，断开后理想电容在零电流时保持已有电压——电压就是它的“满度”，电流就是进出水流。
description.en: Like a tiny reservoir: current into the positive terminal charges it and voltage rises with the stored amount; disconnected, an ideal capacitor holds its voltage at zero current — voltage is its fullness, current the inflow and outflow.

description.zh: 开关是可控的门（Buck/Boost 里轮流开关搬运能量），二极管是只推不拉的单向门：开关断开瞬间，电感电流靠它续流不断——没有它，电流无路可走、电压会冲高。
description.en: A switch is a controllable gate (Buck and Boost converters shuttle energy by switching in turn); a diode is a one-way gate that only pushes, never pulls: the instant a switch opens, the inductor current keeps flowing through it — without it the current would have nowhere to go and the voltage would spike.

description.zh: 在固定周期内改变开关导通时间来“假装”调光：开关闪得比眼睛反应快时，眼睛只感受到平均亮度——占空比（导通时间占周期的比例）越大，看起来越亮。
description.en: Vary switch ON time within a fixed period to fake dimming: flickering faster than the eye can follow, only the average brightness is seen — a larger duty cycle, the fraction of the period spent ON, looks brighter.

description.zh: 电源间歇接入。连续导通 CCM 指电感电流全周期不归零，不是恒定电流。理想周期稳态、直流输入恒定时，周期平均输出电压 ⟨Vout⟩ 为 D 倍输入；瞬时值可有纹波。
description.en: CCM means inductor current never reaches zero during a cycle, not that it stays constant. With ideal components, periodic steady state and constant DC input, cycle-average output voltage ⟨Vout⟩ is D times input; instantaneous voltage can ripple.

description.zh: 先给电感储能，再让电源与电感共同向输出供能。周期平均电压 ⟨Vout⟩ 的关系采用理想小纹波周期稳态近似，要求恒定直流输入、连续导通 CCM（电感电流全周期不归零）及 0<D<1；瞬时值可有纹波。
description.en: Store energy in an inductor, then let source and inductor feed the output. The relation for cycle-average voltage ⟨Vout⟩ uses the ideal small-ripple periodic steady-state approximation with constant DC input, CCM (inductor current never zero) and0<D<1; instantaneous voltage can ripple.

description.zh: 半径为 1 的圆：转过的角度 θ 落在圆上哪一点，它的横坐标就是 cos θ、纵坐标就是 sin θ——转一圈，两个坐标此起彼伏画出正弦余弦；钟面、月相都是它的影子。
description.en: A circle of radius one: wherever the turned angle θ lands on the circle, its horizontal coordinate is cos θ and its vertical coordinate sin θ — one full turn draws sine and cosine rising and falling against each other; clock faces and moon phases are its shadows.

description.zh: 匀速绕圆运动的坐标随时间周期变化。振幅、频率和相位分别决定大小、快慢和起点。
description.en: Coordinates of uniform circular motion vary periodically. Amplitude, frequency and phase set the size, rate and starting point.

title.zh: 相位、弧度与每秒周期数
title.en: Phase, radians and cycles per second

body.zh: θ 表示一周期内的进度。弧度是弧长除以半径，一周为 2π rad。f 是每秒周期数（Hz），T 是一周期的秒数，ω=2πf 是每秒变化的弧度数（rad/s），T=1/f。正弦式中的 φ 设定起始相位。
body.en: θ marks progress through a cycle. A radian angle is arc length divided by radius; one turn is2π rad. f counts cycles per second (Hz), T is seconds per cycle, and ω=2πf measures radians per second; T=1/f. In the sine formula, φ sets the starting phase.

description.zh: 把平面点写成复数后，乘以单位模复数就是旋转：乘以 i 是逆时针转 90°，连乘两次就是转 180°（即乘 −1）；实部和虚部就是这个点的两个坐标。
description.en: Represent a plane point as a complex number, and multiplying by a unit-magnitude complex number rotates it: multiply by i to turn 90° counterclockwise, twice for 180° (that is, multiply by −1). Real and imaginary parts are the point's two coordinates.

nodes.formula: z = cos θ + i sin θ

description.zh: 向量是一组有顺序的数；矩阵把输入向量变为输出向量，并保持加法和数乘。
description.en: A vector is an ordered collection of numbers. A matrix maps vectors while preserving addition and scalar multiplication.

description.zh: 对称矩阵总有一组互相垂直的特殊方向：作用上去只拉长或压短、不转方向——这就是特征向量，拉伸比例 λ 是特征值，它们是变换的“脊梁方向”。（一般实矩阵未必有实特征方向：旋转就没有。）
description.en: A symmetric matrix always has a set of mutually perpendicular special directions: acting on them only stretches or shrinks, never turns — those are eigenvectors, with stretch factor λ the eigenvalue; they are the transformation's spine directions. (A general real matrix need not have real eigendirections: a rotation has none.)

description.zh: 傅里叶只问“含哪些频率”，拉普拉斯多问一句“信号在长大还是衰减”：用 e^{st} 去试探，s 的实部管增长衰减、虚部管振荡；收敛域就是这套试探成立的 s 范围——极点的位置直接告诉你系统会不会发散。
description.en: Fourier asks only 'which frequencies are in it'; Laplace asks one more question, 'is the signal growing or decaying': probe with e^{st}, where the real part of s governs growth or decay and the imaginary part governs oscillation; the region of convergence is the range of s where this probing holds — and pole positions say directly whether the system blows up.

description.zh: 理想弹簧振子的回复力与位移成正比、方向相反。在无阻尼、无持续外力驱动时，位移随时间呈正弦变化；回复力仍然存在。
description.en: An ideal spring has a restoring force proportional and opposite to displacement. Without damping or driving, its motion is sinusoidal.

title.zh: x′ 和 x″ 分别读什么？
title.en: What do x′ and x″ mean?

body.zh: x 是相对平衡位置的坐标（m）。x′=dx/dt 是带方向的速度（m/s）；再对时间求一次导数，x″=d²x/dt² 就是加速度（m/s²）。两个撇号表示求两次导数，不是把 x 平方。
body.en: x is position relative to equilibrium (m). x′=dx/dt is signed velocity (m/s); differentiating once more gives x″=d²x/dt², acceleration (m/s²). Two primes mean two time derivatives, not x squared.

description.zh: 把多个信号在同一时刻的值相加，得到合成信号：两列水波相遇、各走各的路，交汇处的高度就是两者相加。物理系统是否允许这样叠加取决于其线性——线性系统里，复杂输入可以拆成简单输入分别算、再叠起来；非线性系统这招不灵。
description.en: Add several signals' values at the same instant to form a combined signal: two water waves meet and pass through each other, and the height where they cross is their sum. Whether a physical system allows such superposition depends on its linearity — in a linear system a complex input can be split into simple inputs, solved separately and added back; in a nonlinear system that trick fails.

description.zh: 用不同频率的正弦或复指数分量描述信号。周期信号用级数，有限采样数据可用离散傅里叶变换。
description.en: Describe a signal using sinusoidal or complex-exponential components. Periodic signals use a series; finite sampled data can use a discrete Fourier transform.

description.zh: 按频率列出信号分量的幅度与相位——一段音乐、一串语音，频谱就是它的“成分表”：横轴频率、纵轴每种频率占多少。幅度图只展示其中一部分，不能单独还原一般信号：只看幅度丢了相位，就像只看菜谱的配料不看做法。
description.en: List a signal's component amplitudes and phases by frequency — for a piece of music or a stretch of speech, the spectrum is its 'ingredient list': frequency across, each frequency's share up. A magnitude plot alone shows only part of it and cannot reconstruct a general signal: magnitude without phase is like a recipe's ingredients without the method.

description.zh: 像推秋千踩中节拍：受周期驱动的系统，响应幅度可能在某个频率附近出现峰值——外推频率等于固有频率时振幅最大；阻尼越小峰越尖越高，阻尼越大峰越矮越宽，偏一点频率也推得起来一些。
description.en: Like pushing a swing in time: a periodically driven system may respond most strongly near a particular frequency — amplitude peaks when the driving frequency equals the natural frequency. Lighter damping makes the peak taller and sharper; heavier damping makes it lower and wider, so slightly off-frequency pushes still build a little.

description.zh: 按固定时间间隔记录信号。理想带限信号的采样率需高于最高频率的两倍，才能避免频谱重叠。
description.en: Record a signal at fixed intervals. For an ideally band-limited signal, a sampling rate above twice its highest frequency avoids overlapping spectral copies.

description.zh: 线性意味着输入加权组合对应输出的同样组合（可以分开算再叠加）；时不变意味着系统今天和明天一个样——输入推迟多久，输出就推迟多久，形状不变。
description.en: Linearity preserves weighted combinations of inputs (solve parts separately, then add); time invariance means the system behaves the same today and tomorrow — delay the input and the output delays by exactly as much, shape unchanged.

description.zh: 给离散系统输入一个单位脉冲后得到的输出。对初始静止的线性时不变系统，它足以确定任意输入的响应。
description.en: The output produced by a discrete unit impulse. For an initially resting LTI system, it determines the response to any input.

description.zh: 把一个序列翻转、平移，与另一个序列对应相乘后求和；每个位移产生一个输出值——实际就是加权滑动平均：用它平滑信号、模糊图像时，权重序列就是“邻居各占几分”的配方。
description.en: Reverse and shift one sequence, multiply it against another, then sum; each shift produces one output value. In practice it is a weighted moving average — smoothing a signal or blurring an image just picks a weight sequence saying how much each neighbour counts.

description.zh: 对稳定 LTI 系统，频率响应描述正弦输入的稳态幅度与相位变化。连续时间（CT）用 H(iω)，ω 单位 rad/s；离散时间（DT）用 H(e^{iΩ})，Ω 单位 rad/样本。
description.en: For a stable LTI system, frequency response describes steady-state sinusoidal amplitude and phase changes. Continuous time (CT) uses H(iω), with ω in rad/s; discrete time (DT) uses H(e^{iΩ}), with Ω in rad/sample.

description.zh: 极点关联响应中的指数模式。连续时间因果有理系统的传递函数极点全在左半平面时，输入输出稳定。
description.en: Poles describe exponential response modes. A causal continuous-time rational system is input-output stable when all transfer-function poles lie in the left half-plane.

description.zh: 测量输出，与目标比较，再据此调整输入。反馈效果取决于控制器、系统、延迟及噪声。
description.en: Measure an output, compare it with a target, and adjust the input. Results depend on the controller, system, delay and noise.

description.zh: 用概率描述可能结果及其不确定性：扔 100 次硬币大约 50 次正面，但单次扔出什么仍不可预测——概率说的是长期频率，不是单次的保证；模型里的概率还要拿观察证据来检验，不能混为一谈。
description.en: Use probabilities to describe possible outcomes and uncertainty: 100 coin flips land heads about 50 times, yet a single flip stays unpredictable — probability speaks of long-run frequency, not a guarantee for one trial. Model probabilities must still be checked against observed evidence, never confused with it.

description.zh: 先验是观测前的概率，后验是观测后的更新。似然描述给定假设下观测如何出现；本页离散例子中是观测概率。把它与先验结合并归一化，得到依赖观测模型的后验。
description.en: A prior is a probability before evidence; a posterior is its update afterward. Likelihood describes evidence under a hypothesis—in this lesson’s discrete examples it is an observation probability. Combine it with the prior and normalize; the result depends on the observation model.

description.zh: 与均值的偏差平方的期望，用于描述分散程度：平方既消掉正负号，又让偏离大的点代价更大；但单位也成了原单位的平方，所以实用时常开方回到原单位，那就是标准差。
description.en: The expected squared deviation from the mean, measuring spread: squaring removes the sign and punishes large misses more, but it also squares the units — so in practice we take the square root back to the original units, which is the standard deviation.

title.zh: 正态分布与中心极限定理

description.zh: 独立同分布、方差有限且非零时，样本均值经过适当标准化后，随样本量增加趋于标准正态分布。
description.en: For iid samples with finite, nonzero variance, the appropriately standardized sample mean approaches a standard normal distribution as sample size grows.

description.zh: 通过随机样本的平均估计期望或积分：扔 1 万次飞镖估圆面积就是它。误差大小依赖采样方式、样本量及被估计量的方差；样本 ×4、误差大约 ÷2。
description.en: Estimate expectations or integrals from random-sample averages: throwing 10,000 darts to estimate a circle's area is exactly this. Error depends on sampling, sample count and the variance of the quantity estimated; four times the samples roughly halves the error.

description.zh: 先用动态模型预测状态，再根据测量及其不确定性修正。协方差表示模型估计的不确定性，并不保证真实误差同样小。
description.en: Predict a state with a dynamic model, then correct it using measurements and their uncertainty. Covariance describes model uncertainty, not guaranteed real-world error.

description.zh: 线性波在同一点的位移相加；同频等振幅时，到达相位差决定合振幅。相干表示相对相位保持固定。双缝条纹、降噪耳机都是它：同相叠加变响变亮、反相抵消变静变暗——相位差就是明暗的开关。
description.en: Linear-wave displacements add at the same point. For equal-amplitude, equal-frequency waves, arrival phase determines the resultant amplitude; coherence means a fixed relative phase. Double-slit fringes and noise-cancelling headphones are both this: in-phase addition grows louder and brighter, opposite-phase cancellation grows quieter and darker — phase difference is the brightness switch.

body.zh: 源2初相位为φ时，带符号路程差d=r₂−r₁给出δ=φ−2πd/λ。此公式假设P处两列波同频等振幅；振幅不是强度，本课不计算二维能流。
body.en: With source 2 phaseφ and directed d=r₂−r₁, δ=φ−2πd/λ. Equal frequency and equal received amplitude at P are assumed. Amplitude is not intensity; this lesson does not calculate 2D energy flux.

description.zh: 把一次互动写成一张表：每格是双方同时出的招、各自的得分。先找占优策略——不管对手出什么都最划算的那招；再找纳什均衡——谁单独换招都不会更好。拍卖、公地、囚徒困境都是同一张表的不同填法。
description.en: Write one interaction as a table: each cell holds both sides' simultaneous moves and their scores. First find dominant strategies — moves that pay best no matter what the rival does; then Nash equilibria — where neither side improves by switching alone. Auctions, the commons and the prisoner's dilemma are the same table filled in differently.

description.zh: 阳光进来、红外出去，两边账要平：大气二氧化碳加厚，等于给出去的路加了道关卡，出少于进，地表就升温攒热量。气候问题本质是能量收支账，不是单日冷暖。
description.en: Sunlight comes in, infrared goes out, and the two sides must balance: thicker atmospheric CO₂ puts a checkpoint on the way out, so out falls short of in and the surface warms as heat accumulates. Climate is an energy-budget ledger, not a single day's weather.

description.zh: 沿着斜率往下走：每步算损失对每个参数的斜率，参数就往斜率的反方向挪一小步，步长叫学习率。步子太大来回震荡、太小走不到底；一次只看一批数据的叫小批量，是算力与稳定的折中。
description.en: Walk downhill along the slope: each step computes the loss's slope for every parameter, and each parameter moves a small step against the slope; the step size is the learning rate. Too big a step oscillates, too small never arrives; looking at one batch at a time is the mini-batch compromise between compute and stability.

description.zh: 阳光供能，把水和二氧化碳拼成糖、放出氧气：一笔原子账，进来 6 个 CO₂ 加 6 个水，出去 1 个葡萄糖加 6 个氧气。光越强开工越快但有上限，二氧化碳不够时光再强也白搭。
description.en: Sunlight powers assembling water and carbon dioxide into sugar and releasing oxygen — an atom ledger: 6 CO₂ plus 6 waters in, 1 glucose plus 6 oxygens out. Stronger light speeds work up to a ceiling, and when CO₂ runs short extra light is wasted.

description.zh: 买方愿买量随价跌而增、卖方愿卖量随价涨而增，两条曲线交点就是均衡价格：两边都愿意交易的量。价格变化是沿曲线移动，偏好、收入、技术变了才是整条曲线移动。
description.en: Buyers want more as price falls, sellers want more as price rises, and where the two curves cross is the equilibrium price — the quantity both sides plan to trade. A price change moves along a curve; changed tastes, incomes or technology shift the whole curve.

description.zh: 在有序表里找数：先看中间，目标小了往左半找、大了往右半找，每步砍掉一半。n 个数最多约 log₂n 步；无序就没法砍半，只能一个个看。
description.en: Finding a number in a sorted list: look at the middle, go left if the target is smaller, right if bigger, cutting half away each step. n items take about log₂n steps at most; unsorted, halving is impossible and you can only scan one by one.

description.zh: 指数是连乘的简写：2¹⁰ 就是 10 个 2 相乘；对数反过来问，多少次连乘才到这个数——log₂1024 = 10，因为 10 次翻倍到 1024。指数长得快、对数长得慢，同一枚硬币的两面。
description.en: An exponent is shorthand for repeated multiplication: 2¹⁰ is ten 2s multiplied; a logarithm asks the reverse — how many multiplications reach this number — so log₂1024 = 10, because ten doublings reach 1024. Exponents grow fast, logarithms grow slowly: two sides of one coin.

description.zh: 把问题画成点和边，再按规则走：点是地点或状态，边是连接、权重是代价。最短路、PageRank、遍历都是同一套画法换不同规则：每次确认什么、按什么顺序展开，决定了算出什么。
description.en: Draw a problem as vertices and edges, then walk by a rule: vertices are places or states, edges are links, weights are costs. Shortest paths, PageRank and traversals are the same drawing with different rules — what you settle each time, and in what order, decides what you compute.

description.zh: 把任意长的数据压成固定长的指纹：同一个输入永远得到同一串输出，输出改一位、输入面目全非也看不出规律。反过来从指纹倒推原文不可行——这就是单向：正向便宜、反向昂贵，RSA 的锁芯也是同一思想。
description.en: Squeezing any-length data into a fixed-length fingerprint: the same input always gives the same output, and changing one output bit reveals nothing about the input. Reversing a fingerprint back to the original is infeasible — that is one-way: cheap forward, expensive backward, the same idea as RSA's lock.

description.zh: 从读数反推真值：终点读数、刻度、重复测量都有误差，所以估计永远是“数值 ± 不确定度”。不确定度不是错误，是诚实标出这把尺子的可信范围；多测几次平均，不确定度随 1/√n 缩小。
description.en: Working backwards from readings to the true value: end-point readings, scales and repeats all carry error, so an estimate is always "value ± uncertainty". Uncertainty is not a mistake — it honestly marks how far this ruler can be trusted; averaging repeats shrinks it like 1/√n.

description.zh: 速度–时间图：曲线上每点的纵坐标就是那一刻的速度，斜率是加速度，曲线下面积是位移。斜率为正速度在变大、为零速度不变；面积带符号，往回走的那段要减掉。
description.en: A velocity–time graph: each point's height is the velocity at that instant, the slope is acceleration, and the area under the curve is displacement. Positive slope means speeding up, zero slope means steady speed; area carries a sign, so the way-back stretch subtracts.

label.en: uses relative phase to determine resultant amplitude

reason.zh: 同一点的两列线性简谐波逐时相加；同频等振幅且相对相位固定时，B=2A|cos(δ/2)|。这是一条应用连接，不表示必须先学完另一课程。
reason.en: Two linear sinusoids add at the same point and time. For fixed relative phase, equal frequency and equal received amplitude, B=2A|cos(δ/2)|. This is an application, not a required course order.

reason.zh: 单位圆给出sin的值域；Snell关系要求sinθ₂=(n₁/n₂)sinθ₁，右侧超过1时没有传播折射光线。光学角从法线起，而不是单位圆默认的水平轴。
reason.en: The unit circle supplies sine’s range. Snell requires sinθ₂=(n₁/n₂)sinθ₁; above1, no propagating refracted ray exists. Optical angles start at the normal, rather than the unit circle’s usual horizontal axis.

label.zh: 用同一直线得到相似比
label.en: uses one straight line to obtain the ratio

reason.zh: 以孔心为原点，同一条非竖直光线保持斜率；孔两侧三角形相似，坐标反号给出带符号放大率M=−v/u。光线斜率与放大率不是同一个量，这个关系不是透镜焦距公式。
reason.en: With the hole as origin, a nonvertical ray keeps one slope. Similar triangles on opposite sides reverse the coordinate sign, giving signed magnification M=−v/u. Ray slope and magnification are different quantities; this is not a lens focal-length formula.

label.zh: 把电压面积换成电流改变量
label.en: maps voltage area to current change

reason.zh: 恒定理想L、被动端口符号下，∫vL dt=L[iL(b)−iL(a)]。有符号伏秒决定电流改变量，不是能量；重复周期净面积为零时电流回到起值，不必为零。暂态区间不要求平衡。
reason.en: For constant ideal L with passive terminal signs, ∫vL dt=L[iL(b)−iL(a)]. Signed voltseconds determine current change, not energy. Zero net area over a repeating period returns current to its initial value, not necessarily zero. Transient intervals need not balance.

reason.zh: 一维功沿路径积 F dx，单位 N·m=J；a、b 可选时间端点，但积分变量 x 是位移，不是时间。弹簧往返时各段可做正功或负功。
reason.en: One-dimensional work integrates F dx along the path, in N·m=J. Time bounds a,b choose endpoint positions, but the integration variable x is displacement, not time. Spring work can be positive or negative along different legs.

label.zh: 把净功联系到动能变化
label.en: connects net work with kinetic change

reason.zh: 本例重力与支持力都不做功，弹簧力做功即物块净功。换系统或添加阻尼/驱动后，不能把单个力的功直接等同净功，也不能照搬本例机械能守恒。
reason.en: Here weight and support do zero work, so spring work is the block’s net work. In another system or with damping/driving, one force’s work is not generally net work, and this mechanical-energy conservation statement does not transfer automatically.

reason.zh: 本振子往返一周回到同一位置，正负速度贡献抵消，位移为零；路程为4A。交换积分限使有向积分变号，按时间先后的路程仍非负。
reason.en: One oscillator cycle returns to the same position: opposite velocity contributions cancel, giving zero displacement but distance4A. Reversing limits changes an oriented integral’s sign; chronological path length remains nonnegative.

label.zh: 把电流读成电压变化率

reason.zh: 对恒定理想电容，q=Cv且i=dq/dt，所以i=C·dv/dt；电流流入电压标正的端子。零电流保持已有电压；这不是漏电或电阻充电模型，也不是必修顺序。
reason.en: For constant ideal capacitance, q=Cv and i=dq/dt give i=C·dv/dt, with current entering the voltage-positive terminal. Zero current preserves existing voltage; this is not leakage or resistive charging, nor a mandatory learning order.

reason.zh: 本振子的可微位置 x(t) 给出 v=dx/dt、a=dv/dt；有方向的速度可以为负，速率是 |v|。微分描述运动，不是产生运动的物理原因。
reason.en: For this oscillator, v=dx/dt and a=dv/dt. Signed velocity can be negative; speed is |v|. Differentiation describes motion rather than causing it.

reason.zh: 本水平无摩擦弹簧模型中，竖直重力与支持力抵消，水平合外力为 −kx=ma。不能把单个弹簧力在其他系统中也当作净力。
reason.en: In this horizontal frictionless spring model, weight and support cancel vertically; horizontal net force is −kx=ma. A single spring force is not generally the net force in other systems.

reason.zh: 电感电流有惯性、不能突变：功率进出改变的是磁场储能——P=VI 讲的是电流被推快或推慢的速度，而不是某一刻的存量。
reason.en: An inductor's current has inertia and cannot jump: power in or out changes the stored magnetic energy — P=VI tells how fast the current is pushed up or slowed down, not how much is stored at one instant.

reason.zh: 电容存的能量只能靠功率进出改变，功率等于电压乘电流——它告诉你电容充放电有多快，而不是只报一个静态数值。
reason.en: A capacitor's stored energy changes only through power in or out, and power equals voltage times current — it tells how fast the capacitor charges or discharges, not just a static number.

reason.zh: 电感记住电流，电容记住电压；两者在电路中交换储能，但元件定律不同。
reason.en: Inductors retain current and capacitors retain voltage. Both exchange stored energy, under different component laws.

reason.zh: 开关断开后，电感通过续流二极管继续向输出送电。
reason.en: When the switch opens, the inductor continues delivering current through the freewheel diode.

reason.zh: 关断时电感电流下降，电感右端电势升高，电源与电感共同供能。
reason.en: During OFF, current falls and the right inductor terminal rises; source and inductor deliver energy together.

reason.zh: 电感电流与负载电流的差流入或流出输出电容。
reason.en: The difference between inductor and load current charges or discharges the output capacitor.

reason.zh: 开关闭合时二极管截止，负载由输出电容供电。
reason.en: During ON the diode blocks, and the output capacitor supplies the load.

reason.zh: 开关闭合连接输入；开关断开时续流二极管提供回路。
reason.en: The closed switch connects the input; the freewheel diode provides the OFF loop.

reason.zh: 开关闭合给电感储能，断开时电流经二极管流向输出。
reason.en: ON stores energy in the inductor; OFF routes current through the diode to the output.

reason.zh: 占空比 D 就是开关接通输入的时间占比：伏秒平衡下，输出平均电压等于 D·Vin——调 D 就是调输出，D 越大输出越高。
reason.en: The duty ratio D is the fraction of time the switch connects the input: volt-second balance then makes the average output D·Vin — turning D turns the output, larger D giving higher output.

reason.zh: 在恒定直流输入、理想 CCM 的小纹波周期稳态近似下，平均电压 ⟨Vout⟩ ≈ Vin/(1−D)，0<D<1。
reason.en: With constant DC input, ideal CCM and the small-ripple periodic steady-state approximation, ⟨Vout⟩ ≈ Vin/(1−D), with0<D<1.

reason.zh: 实际稳压器可测量输出并调节占空比；本课只解释此接口，不模拟控制器。
reason.en: A real regulator can measure output and adjust duty; this lesson explains the connection without simulating a controller.

reason.zh: 圆上点的纵、横坐标定义正弦、余弦；匀速转动使这些坐标成为时间函数。
reason.en: Vertical and horizontal coordinates define sine and cosine; uniform rotation makes them functions of time.

reason.zh: 单位圆上的点可以写成 cos θ + i sin θ，角度变化对应平面旋转。
reason.en: A point on the unit circle is cos θ + i sin θ; changing its angle rotates it in the plane.

reason.zh: 无阻尼、无持续外力驱动（回复力仍存在）的理想弹簧振子满足 x″ + (k/m)x = 0，其解为正弦和余弦的组合。
reason.en: An ideal spring without damping or sustained driving, with its restoring force still present, obeys x″ + (k/m)x = 0, whose solutions combine sine and cosine.

title.zh: 这是一种表示方式，不是必修箭头
title.en: A representation, not a mandatory learning order

meaning.zh: 正弦／余弦函数描述理想弹簧的位移怎样变化，并不产生运动。圆周投影是看懂这个函数的辅助图像；弹簧块实际沿直线往返，不沿圆周运动。
meaning.en: Sine and cosine describe how an ideal spring’s position changes; they do not cause the motion. Circular projection helps visualize that function. The spring mass travels along a line, not around the circle.

startHint.zh: 如果振幅、频率或相位还陌生，可先看正弦与余弦；已经熟悉就直接试投影实验，不必按箭头重新学一遍。
startHint.en: If amplitude, frequency or phase are unfamiliar, revisit sine and cosine first. If familiar, try the projection experiment directly; the arrow does not require repeating a course.

bounds.zh: 这里限定 m、k 为正的理想线性弹簧，无阻尼、无持续驱动，回复力仍然存在。圆点匀速转动，不代表它的投影匀速往返；其他往返运动不一定符合这套模型。
bounds.en: This comparison uses a positive-mass, positive-stiffness ideal linear spring without damping or sustained driving; its restoring force remains. Constant-speed rotation does not make the projection’s velocity constant. Other oscillations need not fit this model.

reason.zh: 傅里叶分析以不同频率的正弦、余弦或复指数为分量；每个分量有自己的幅度和相位。
reason.en: Fourier analysis uses sine, cosine or complex-exponential components at different frequencies, with their own amplitudes and phases.

reason.zh: 欧拉公式把正弦和余弦写成复指数的组合，复数傅里叶变换由此统一表示正、负频率分量。
reason.en: Euler’s formula expresses sine and cosine as combinations of complex exponentials, allowing the complex Fourier transform to represent positive and negative frequencies together.

reason.zh: 傅里叶级数通过叠加谐波近似周期波形；有限项近似在跳变附近可能出现吉布斯现象。
reason.en: A Fourier series combines harmonics to approximate a periodic waveform; finite sums may show Gibbs overshoot near jumps.

reason.zh: 变换结果包含各频率分量的信息；查看幅度与相位，才能保留一般信号的完整表示。
reason.en: The transform records frequency components; both amplitude and phase are needed for a complete representation of a general signal.

reason.zh: 当相应变换存在时，时域卷积对应频域乘法。本课用有限序列比较直接卷积与频域计算的结果。
reason.en: When the transforms exist, time-domain convolution corresponds to frequency-domain multiplication. This lesson compares direct convolution with frequency-domain computation on finite sequences.

reason.zh: 均匀采样使频谱按采样率周期重复；重复的谱相互重叠时产生混叠。
reason.en: Uniform sampling repeats the spectrum at multiples of the sampling rate; overlap between copies produces aliasing.

label.zh: 受周期驱动时可能共振

reason.zh: 给振子施加周期外力，其稳态响应随驱动频率变化；阻尼决定峰值的强弱与位置。
reason.en: A periodic force produces a frequency-dependent steady-state response; damping affects the peak strength and location.

reason.zh: 在线性系统的频率响应幅度图上，共振表现为某段频率附近的峰；并非所有系统都有明显峰值。
reason.en: In a linear system’s frequency-response magnitude, resonance appears as a peak; not every system has a pronounced one.

label.en: is characterized by its impulse response

reason.zh: 对初始静止的 LTI 系统，把输入分解为加权、平移的单位脉冲，就能由 h 重建输出。
reason.en: For an initially resting LTI system, decompose the input into weighted shifted impulses and reconstruct the output from h.

label.en: convolves with input to produce output

reason.zh: 输出是各个平移冲激响应的加权和，这正是离散卷积 y[n] = Σ x[k]h[n−k]。
reason.en: The output sums weighted shifted impulse responses: precisely the discrete convolution y[n] = Σ x[k]h[n−k].

label.zh: 时域卷积成为频域相乘

reason.zh: 对零初态离散LTI系统，y=x*h；当相应变换存在时，Y(e^{iΩ})=X(e^{iΩ})H(e^{iΩ})。h绝对可和可保证稳定频率响应。Ω单位为rad/样本，不能直接当成Hz。
reason.en: For an initially resting discrete LTI system, y=x*h. When the transforms exist, Y(e^{iΩ})=X(e^{iΩ})H(e^{iΩ}); absolute summability of h ensures a stable frequency response. Ω is rad/sample, not directly Hz.

label.zh: 傅里叶变换给出频率响应

reason.zh: 离散 h[n] 的离散时间傅里叶变换是 H(e^{iΩ})，Ω 单位 rad/样本；连续 h(t) 的傅里叶积分是 H(iω)，ω 单位 rad/s。变换需存在；稳定系统的绝对可和/可积是相应充分条件。不能把 δ[n] 与连续冲激直接混用。
reason.en: The DTFT of discrete h[n] is H(e^{iΩ}), with Ω in rad/sample; the Fourier integral of continuous h(t) is H(iω), with ω in rad/s. The transform must exist; absolute summability/integrability supplies the respective stable-system condition. A discrete unit impulse is not a continuous Dirac impulse.

reason.zh: 线性保证输入的加权组合产生相同权重的输出组合；时不变是另一项独立条件。
reason.en: Linearity preserves weighted combinations of input-output pairs; time invariance is a separate condition.

label.zh: 在收敛条件下限制到虚轴
label.en: restricts to the imaginary axis when convergent

reason.zh: 当拉普拉斯变换的收敛域包含虚轴时，在 s = iω 处取值可得到傅里叶变换。
reason.en: If the Laplace region of convergence contains the imaginary axis, evaluating at s = iω gives the Fourier transform.

reason.zh: 对本课中的有理变换，极点的实部关联增长或衰减，虚部关联振荡；还要结合因果性和收敛域判断稳定性。
reason.en: For the rational transforms in this lesson, pole real parts describe growth or decay and imaginary parts describe oscillation; stability also depends on causality and convergence.

reason.zh: 当冲激响应的拉普拉斯收敛域包含虚轴时，H(iω) 给出频率响应。极点靠近虚轴可能形成尖峰，零点也会影响结果。
reason.en: When the Laplace region of convergence of the impulse response contains the imaginary axis, H(iω) gives frequency response. Nearby poles may produce sharp peaks; zeros also matter.

reason.zh: 在矩阵变换下寻找只被缩放的非零向量，就得到 Av = λv 的特征向量问题。
reason.en: Finding nonzero vectors that are only scaled by a matrix leads to the eigenvector equation Av = λv.

reason.zh: 对协方差矩阵，特征向量给出互相正交的主方向，特征值给出沿这些方向的方差。
reason.en: For a covariance matrix, an orthonormal eigenbasis gives principal directions, and eigenvalues give variances along them.

label.en: provides a model for evidence updates

reason.zh: 先验和似然都来自概率模型；贝叶斯公式将它们结合成给定观测后的条件概率。
reason.en: The prior and likelihood come from a probability model; Bayes’ rule combines them into a probability conditional on observations.

label.zh: 在线性高斯条件下形成状态更新
label.en: gives state updates under linear Gaussian assumptions

reason.zh: 在线性动态与观测模型、适当高斯先验和独立高斯噪声条件下，卡尔曼更新可用均值与协方差表示贝叶斯更新。
reason.en: With linear dynamics and measurements, an appropriate Gaussian prior and independent Gaussian noises, Kalman updates express Bayesian updating using means and covariances.

reason.zh: 预测不确定性与测量噪声共同决定增益；模型给出的不确定性必须与真实估计误差区分。
reason.en: Predicted uncertainty and measurement noise jointly determine the gain; model uncertainty must be distinguished from actual estimation error.

label.zh: 提供用于控制的状态估计

reason.zh: 无法直接观测的状态可先估计，再交给控制器；估计质量和模型误差会影响控制效果。
reason.en: Estimate states that cannot be measured directly, then pass them to a controller; estimation quality and model mismatch affect control.

label.en: sets the standard error of a mean

reason.zh: 独立同分布的单个观测总体方差为 σ² 时，n 个样本的均值方差为 σ²/n；正态近似还需要适用的极限定理条件。
reason.en: For iid observations each having population variance σ², the mean of n samples has variance σ²/n; a normal approximation additionally needs appropriate limit-theorem conditions.

reason.zh: 按指定概率模型采样，用样本平均估计期望；积分也可改写成相应的期望。
reason.en: Sample from a specified probability model and average to estimate an expectation; integrals can also be written as expectations.

reason.zh: 独立同分布且方差有限时，样本平均的标准误差按 1/√n 缩小；这是误差尺度，不是每次运行的保证。
reason.en: For iid samples with finite variance, the sample mean’s standard error scales as 1/√n; this is an error scale, not a guarantee for each run.

label.zh: 描述独立变量相加的分布

reason.zh: 独立随机变量之和的分布由卷积给出；反复相加后的正态近似需满足中心极限定理的条件。
reason.en: Convolution gives the distribution of a sum of independent random variables; a normal approximation after repeated sums requires central-limit conditions.

title.zh: 样本四倍，每次误差都减半吗？
title.en: Four times the samples: does every error halve?

question.zh: 原始数据的分散，和平均值的分散一样吗？
question.en: Is data spread the same as the spread of its mean?

action.zh: 打开CLT第3步，保留均匀U(0,1)，按“一次跑完”。比较样本量n与4n的均值标准差。
action.en: Open CLT step3,keep uniformU(0,1),then Run all. Compare the standard deviation of means at n and4n.

observe.zh: 理论上单个观测方差为σ²，n个独立观测的均值方差为σ²/n，标准误差为σ/√n。实测拟合和标准差比有波动，不必恰等−0.5或0.5。
observe.en: One observation has population varianceσ²; the mean of n independent observations has varianceσ²/n and SEσ/√n. Empirical fitted slopes/SD ratios fluctuate; they need not be exactly−0.5 or0.5.

bridge.zh: 下一站换成圆内0/1命中和πHat=4×命中率。N是每次估计的点数，20是重复次数；不传递这页的分布或参数。
bridge.en: Next switch to inside/outside0/1 hits and πHat=4×hit rate. N is points per estimate;20 is replications. This page’s distribution/parameters are not transferred.

question.zh: 同样N，为什么20次估计并不相同？
question.en: Why do20 estimates differ at the same N?

action.zh: 选择“20颗种子同跑”，依次按“每次N=100／400／1600”。这些键暂停并重放同一种子的前缀。比较轨迹束、20次估计的样本标准差和理论SE；可换种子再看。
action.en: Choose20 seeds at once,then N100/400/1600. These buttons pause and replay prefixes of the same seeds. Compare the bundle,20-estimate sampleSD and theoreticalSE; optionally change seed and repeat.

observe.zh: N四倍使理论SE减半；一次误差和20次的样本标准差可能不减半，甚至变大。浅带用已知π作教学参照，不是未知π的置信区间或整条轨迹的保证。
observe.en: Four times N halves theoreticalSE. One error or the sampleSD of20 runs need not halve,and can increase. The pale band uses knownπ as a teaching reference,not a confidence interval for unknownπ or a whole-trajectory guarantee.

bridge.zh: 展开“这些方差各指什么”：0/1数据的样本方差、π估计的理论方差及其平方根SE有不同对象。20次估计的样本SD也不是20次均值的SE。
bridge.en: Expand “Which variance is which?”: samplevariance of0/1data,theoreticalvariance of π estimates and its square-rootSE describe different objects. The20-estimate sampleSD is not the SE of their average.

title.zh: 平均电压为零，为何电流不停？
title.en: Zero average voltage: why does current continue?

question.zh: 有符号累加，究竟累加什么？
question.en: What does a signed integral accumulate?

action.zh: 打开积分第2步，增加切条数并比较左端／中点／右端取高。这里的v是速度，不是电压。
action.en: Open integral step2. Increase strip count and compare left/mid/right samples. Here v is velocity, not voltage.

observe.zh: 速度×时间累加成位移；本例v=t≥0，精确位移2m。换成电压vL时，面积单位变为V·s，不是m或J。
observe.en: Velocity times time accumulates displacement; here v=t≥0 gives exact displacement2m. Switching to voltage vL changes area units toV·s, not metres or joules.

bridge.zh: 下一站换理想电感：积电压，再除以电感量，得到电流的改变量，不是绝对电流。
bridge.en: Next change to an ideal inductor: integrate voltage and divide by inductance to obtain a current change, not absolute current.

evidenceLabel.zh: Analog Devices · 电感斜率与伏秒平衡 ↗
evidenceLabel.en: Analog Devices · current ramps and volt-second balance ↗

question.zh: 零电压，会把已有电流清零吗？
question.en: Does zero voltage erase an existing current?

action.zh: 重置电感，依次按+2V两次、0V一次、−2V一次，看电流曲线。每次0.5ms，L=10mH。
action.en: Reset the inductor. Apply+2V twice,0V once,then−2V once. Each interval is0.5ms with L=10mH.

observe.en: Current goes0→0.1→0.2→0.2→0.1A. Each signed rectangle is±0.001V·s; dividing by0.01H gives±0.1A. Zero voltage keeps0.2A.

bridge.zh: 下一站是不同参数的Buck：L=1mH，周期50µs，初态已取稳态谷值；不会传递这里的电流或脉冲。
bridge.en: Next is a different Buck case: L=1mH,period50µs, starting at a steady-state valley. No current or pulse parameters transfer.

evidenceLabel.zh: Analog Devices · 电感斜率与伏秒平衡 ↗
evidenceLabel.en: Analog Devices · current ramps and volt-second balance ↗

question.zh: 正负电压面积抵消，电流也为零吗？
question.en: If voltage areas cancel, must current be zero?

action.zh: 设置Vin=12V、D=50%，展开“从刚才的斜率推导输出电压”，按“查看ON结束”与“查看一周期”。保持一周期时刻，再把D改75%，比较填色面积。
action.en: Set Vin=12V,D=50%. Expand “Derive output voltage from those slopes”; use Inspect ON end,then Inspect one period. Keep the one-period time and change D to75%; compare the filled areas.

observe.zh: 默认ON结束：+150Vµs，Δi=+0.15A；一周期+150与−150抵消，电流回到0.925A，不是零。D=75%时矩形高宽都变，净面积仍为零。
observe.en: At default ON end:+150Vµs,Δi=+0.15A. At one period,+150 and−150 cancel; current returns to0.925A,not zero. D=75% changes rectangle heights/widths while net area remains zero.

bridge.zh: 这是已建立的理想周期稳态；调参比较另一个稳态，不模拟启动或控制器。任意暂态区间仍满足积分关系，但未必伏秒平衡。
bridge.en: This is an established ideal periodic steady state. Parameter edits compare another steady case,not startup or a controller. The integral relation still holds during a transient,but its voltage area need not balance.

evidenceLabel.zh: Analog Devices · 电感斜率与伏秒平衡 ↗
evidenceLabel.en: Analog Devices · current ramps and volt-second balance ↗

title.zh: 电流为零，电压为何还在？
title.en: Zero current: why does voltage remain?

question.zh: 曲线的高度，等于它的变化率吗？
question.en: Is a curve’s height the same as its rate of change?

action.zh: 打开导数第2步，把P点横坐标x设为−1、0、1，对比y=x²的切线与导数图。
action.en: Open derivative step2. Set probe x to−1,0,1 and compare the tangent to y=x² with its derivative plot.

observe.zh: y分别为1、0、1，解析斜率分别是−2、0、2；同样高度也可以一边下降、一边上升。数值差商是近似值，不冒充解析等式。
observe.en: Heights are1,0,1, while analytic slopes are−2,0,2. Equal height can accompany falling or rising. The numeric finite-difference readout is approximate, not an exact analytic equality.

bridge.zh: 下一站换成电压v对时间t的曲线，不传递x²参数。斜率单位变为V/s，理想电容电流等于电容量乘这个变化率。
bridge.en: Next change examples to voltage v versus time t; x² parameters are not transferred. Slope has unitsV/s, and ideal capacitor current equals capacitance times this rate.

evidenceLabel.zh: OpenStax9.1 · 电流是电荷变化率 ↗

question.zh: 不再流入电荷，电压会消失吗？
question.en: If charge stops arriving, does voltage disappear?

action.zh: 先重置电容，再依次按两次+20mA、一次0mA、一次−20mA。对比完整电压曲线与“最后一个区间”的横向时间、纵向Δv。
action.en: Reset the capacitor, then press+20mA twice,0mA once and−20mA once. Compare the full voltage trace with the last interval’s horizontal time and vertical Δv.

observe.zh: C=100µF、每段0.5ms：电压0→0.1→0.2→0.2→0.1V。三种电流对应段内斜率+200、0、−200V/s。零电流留下0.2V；负电流可继续使带符号电压穿过零点。
observe.en: At C=100µF and0.5ms per interval: voltage goes0→0.1→0.2→0.2→0.1V. The three currents give within-segment slopes+200,0,−200V/s. Zero current leaves0.2V; negative current can take signed voltage throughzero.

bridge.zh: 由q=Cv与i=dq/dt得到i=C·dv/dt。本模型每段恒流，所以区间斜率恰等段内导数；电流真正跳变处电压没有双侧导数。新文档重载会重置脉冲；返回地图保留站点。
bridge.en: q=Cv and i=dq/dt give i=C·dv/dt. Each segment has constant current, so its interval slope equals the interior derivative; at a true current jump voltage has no two-sided derivative. New-document reload resets pulses; Back retains the Atlas station.

title.zh: 移动平均为什么能消掉一个频率？
title.en: Why can a moving average cancel one frequency?

evidenceLabel.zh: LTI课程 · 叠加与延迟检验 ↗
evidenceLabel.en: LTI lesson · superposition and delay tests ↗

action.zh: 打开公理检验台：比较累加器与平方器的叠加性偏差。再看时变增益的延迟检验。
action.en: Open the axiom bench. Compare the accumulator and squarer under superposition, then inspect the time-varying gain under a delay.

observe.zh: 平方器的反例否定线性；时变增益可以线性却不时不变。几组输入通过检验不等于对任意输入的证明。
observe.en: The squarer supplies a counterexample to linearity; time-varying gain can be linear without time invariance. Passing a few inputs is not a proof for all inputs.

bridge.zh: 接下来固定使用零初态的3点平均器，看看它的h怎样决定输出。
bridge.en: Next, fix a zero-initial 3-point moving average and inspect how its h determines output.

evidenceLabel.en: LTI lesson · weighted copies of h ↗

question.zh: 三根等高的h，怎样改变输入？
question.en: What do three equal taps do to the input?

action.zh: 选“3点滑动平均”，比较输入与输出图；可点击“播放输入／播放处理后”。查看每份平移h的叠加。
action.en: Choose “3-point moving average”. Compare the input/output plots; optionally play input and processed sound. Inspect the shifted copies of h.

observe.zh: h[0]=h[1]=h[2]=1/3，其他项为0。输出取最近3点的平均；相邻项可能相加，也可能抵消。试听是明确时间映射的合成模式，不是实录。
observe.en: h[0]=h[1]=h[2]=1/3, zero elsewhere. Each output averages the latest 3 samples; terms can reinforce or cancel. Audition uses an explicitly mapped synthetic pattern, not a recording.

bridge.zh: 下一站换一组便于手算的f、g，把同一种卷积运算拆成每项乘积；不会自动同步这页的数值。
bridge.en: The next lesson changes to small hand-calculation arrays f and g to unpack the same convolution operation. It does not transfer this page’s parameters.

question.zh: 一个输出点，到底把哪些项加起来？
question.en: Which terms make one output sample?

action.zh: 先保留默认f=[1,2,3,2,1]、g=[1,0,−1]。按“单步”观察核翻转、对齐、相乘、求和；改一个核值后直接单步重算；“重置”会恢复默认数值。
action.en: Keep default f=[1,2,3,2,1] and g=[1,0,−1]. Use Step to inspect flip, alignment, products and sum. After editing a kernel value, step again to recompute; Reset restores the defaults.

observe.zh: 每列乘积是f[k]g[n−k]，把重叠列相加才得到该n的输出。这组g不是上一站的平均核；运算相同，数值例子不同。
observe.en: Each column contributes f[k]g[n−k]; summing overlapping columns gives output at n. This g is not the previous averaging kernel: same operation, different example.

bridge.zh: 回到3点平均器，用正弦作输入：在频域，这份卷积可以用一个复数倍率H表达。
bridge.en: Return to the 3-point average with a sinusoidal input. In frequency, this convolution is represented by a complex multiplier H.

question.zh: 平均3点，为什么能让一个正弦消失？
question.en: Why can a 3-point average cancel a sinusoid?

action.zh: 将平均长度M设为3，再点“送零点频率2π/M”。先预测：保持频率不动，改M=2，还会完全抵消吗？观察下方输出波形。
action.en: Set average length M=3, then use the exact first-zero 2π/M preset. Predict: keep frequency unchanged and set M=2. Will cancellation remain complete? Inspect the output waveform.

observe.zh: Ω=2π/3 rad/样本时，3个相隔该相位的贡献相加为0；M=2时幅值比为1/2。零点指正弦建立后的响应，不保证启动的前两点为0，也不代表上一站多频试听全静音。不要手输四舍五入的2.094来冒充精确零点。
observe.en: At Ω=2π/3 rad/sample, the 3 phase-shifted contributions sum to zero; M=2 gives magnitude 1/2. This describes the established sinusoidal response, not necessarily the first 2 startup samples, nor silence of the earlier multi-frequency clip. Use the exact preset, not rounded 2.094.

bridge.zh: 把h的逐项乘加与H的幅相联系起来：这是同一固定LTI系统的两种表示，不是新的滤波器。
bridge.en: Connect the multiply-and-sum view of h to the magnitude/phase of H: two representations of one fixed LTI system, not a new filter.

title.zh: 角从哪里量，何时没有折射角？
title.en: Where does the angle start, and when is refraction impossible?

title.zh: 一条直线，怎样得到小孔倒像？
title.en: How does one straight line produce an inverted image?

title.zh: 往返净功为零，途中能量去哪了？
title.en: Zero return work: where did the energy go?

title.zh: 回到起点，为什么还走了路？
title.en: Back at the start: where did the distance go?

title.zh: 圆的投影，为什么像弹簧？
title.en: Why does a circle’s projection match a spring?

backgroundNote.zh: 本实验有阻尼与持续驱动；下面的自由振子方程只用于回看符号。暂态是初始状态带来的额外运动，在本页正阻尼模型中会衰减。稳态是随后保留的持续周期运动，不是静止；黏性阻尼通过反向于速度的力耗能。响应图中的 φ 是位移相对驱动力的相位差。
backgroundNote.en: This lab has damping and sustained driving; the free-spring equation below is background for its symbols. A transient is extra motion associated with the initial state; it decays in this positive-damping model. Steady state is the sustained periodic motion left afterward, not rest. Viscous damping removes energy through a force opposing velocity. Here φ is displacement’s phase difference relative to the driving force.
